name: Operational Zone of the Alpine Foothills
wikipedia: Operational Zone of the Alpine Foothills

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Italy
predecessors.text: 'the provinces of Belluno, Bolzano and Trento'; the page says the Germans restored the 1919 provincial borders, plus Belluno

successors.name: Kingdom of Italy
successors.text: 'given back to Italy only in 1947 when it had become a Republic'; Bolzano was first placed under military occupation

ledger.x: 10 September 1943: the Wehrmacht sets up the Operational Zone of the Alpine Foothills.
10 September 1943: the zone is administered with the Reichsgau Tirol-Vorarlberg.
May 1945: the Operational Zone of the Alpine Foothills ends.

certainty.note: The zone follows the provincial borders of Belluno, Bolzano and Trento (the page says the Germans restored the 1919 provincial borders, plus Belluno).
